meta.name: Run synthetic campaign focus groups with Claude and Google Sheets and SendGrid

parameters.content:
## Synthetic Focus Group

This workflow tests a marketing campaign against a panel of AI personas built from your ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) segments, before you spend a cent on media. It simulates how distinct customer segments would actually react to the copy, aggregates that into a transparent, deterministic appeal score, and has AI synthesize the panel's reactions into a launch recommendation — with every test logged for tracking campaign quality over time.

The appeal score is deliberately NOT left entirely to the AI. Purchase intent, clarity, sentiment, objection density, and share rate — each weighted by how important that ICP segment is to you — are combined into a numeric 0-100 score with a plain formula in code, so the number behind every recommendation is explainable and reproducible. AI is used where it adds real value: role-playing distinct, in-character persona reactions to your actual copy, and writing a clear, human-readable synthesis and set of suggested edits on top of that score.

### Who's it for
- Growth and lifecycle marketers who want a fast gut-check on campaign copy before it goes to a media buy or send
- Brand and creative teams who want to catch confusing offers or off-tone copy before customers do
- Anyone replacing informal "send it to the team Slack channel" campaign reviews with a structured, repeatable test
- Teams who want a lightweight, directional pre-test when a real customer panel or A/B test isn't feasible for every campaign

### How it works
1. Marketer submits campaign copy, channel, offer details, brand voice, and their ICP segments (with relative importance weights) via webhook POST
2. Code builds a persona panel from those ICP segments, normalizing the segment weights so they sum to 1
3. AI role-plays each persona reacting in-character to the actual campaign copy — sentiment, purchase intent, clarity, objections, and whether they'd share it — and reports its own confidence that the campaign copy was clear enough to simulate against
4. Campaigns too thin or garbled to simulate confidently are sent straight back for clearer copy, instead of generating a false-confidence score
5. Code combines every persona's reaction, weighted by that segment's importance, into a composite 0-100 appeal score and readiness tier
6. AI reviews the aggregate scores and every persona's actual reaction and writes a synthesis: an overall recommendation (Launch As-Is, Launch with Minor Edits, Revise Before Launch, Do Not Launch), an executive summary, strengths, risks, and specific suggested copy changes
7. Every test is logged to Google Sheets regardless of outcome, building a history of campaign quality over time
8. Launch-ready campaigns get a notification to the growth marketing team; anything needing work notifies the creative team with the specific suggested changes
9. Webhook responds with the full report, composite score, and per-persona breakdown as JSON

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add Anthropic Claude credentials and attach to both Anthropic model nodes
3. Add SendGrid credentials and replace YOUR_SENDGRID_API_KEY in both email nodes
4. Replace growth-marketing@youragency.com and creative-team@youragency.com with your real team addresses
5. Switch the Google Sheets HTTP node to the native Google Sheets node with OAuth2, or add OAuth2 credentials directly
6. Replace YOUR_SHEET_ID with your actual Spreadsheet ID
7. Set up your Google Sheet with a FocusGroupReports tab (column layout below)
8. Activate and POST a test campaign to the webhook URL

### Requirements
- Anthropic Claude API key (claude-sonnet-4 recommended)
- SendGrid API key for email delivery
- Google Sheets with OAuth2 credentials (FocusGroupReports tab)
- n8n instance with a publicly accessible webhook URL

### How to customize
- Adjust the scoring weights and readiness-tier thresholds in JS - Calculate Aggregate Campaign Scores to match how your team values purchase intent vs. clarity vs. sentiment
- Raise or lower the simulation-confidence gate in IF - Panel Reactions Usable (default: confidence >= 4)
- Add more or fewer ICP segments in the icpSegmentsJson payload field — the persona panel scales automatically
- Feed real historical campaign performance back in as a weighting input so the model calibrates against your actual results over time
- Add a second synthesis pass focused specifically on subject-line or CTA variants for A/B testing

### Important note
This workflow produces a directional, pre-spend signal to support human marketers, not a guarantee of real-world campaign performance. Synthetic personas are a proxy for real customer reactions, not a replacement for actual user testing, and should be treated as one input among several before a launch decision.

### Google Sheets Column Layout

FocusGroupReports tab - row 1 headers:
Campaign ID | Campaign Name | Channel | Budget At Stake | Panel Size | Composite Appeal Score | Readiness Tier | Weighted Purchase Intent | Weighted Clarity | Overall Recommendation | Top Risks | Decided At

## Stage 1: Intake, Persona Panel Build & Simulated Reactions

Accepts a campaign submission via webhook POST, including the raw campaign copy, channel, brand voice, offer details, and a JSON array of ICP segments with relative importance weights. All fields have sensible defaults so the workflow can be tested without a payload.

JS - Build Persona Panel is pure code, not AI: it parses the ICP segments, falls back to two generic segments if the input is missing or malformed, and normalizes every segment's weight so they sum to 1.

The persona-reaction AI (claude-sonnet-4, temperature 0.7 for varied, distinct voices) role-plays each persona in the panel reacting in-character to the actual campaign copy, and reports its own confidence that the copy was clear enough to simulate against.

JS - Parse Persona Reactions Output extracts the AI JSON with a fallback that builds neutral placeholder reactions (and a low confidence score) if parsing fails, so a bad AI response can't silently masquerade as a real signal.

IF - Panel Reactions Usable sends campaigns straight back for clearer copy when the AI's own simulation confidence is too low, instead of scoring against a shaky simulation.

## Stage 2: Aggregate Scoring & AI Synthesis

JS - Calculate Aggregate Campaign Scores is pure code, not AI: it combines every persona's purchase intent, clarity, sentiment, objections, and share likelihood — weighted by that segment's importance — into a composite 0-100 appeal score and readiness tier, and surfaces the most frequently repeated objections across the panel.

A Wait buffer respects API rate limits before the next AI call.

The synthesis AI (claude-sonnet-4, temperature 0.3 for consistent, grounded judgment) reviews the composite score, the readiness tier, and every persona's actual reaction, then writes an overall recommendation, an executive summary, strengths, risks, and specific suggested copy changes.

JS - Parse Synthesis Output & Format Report Record extracts that JSON with a conservative fallback: if parsing fails, the campaign defaults to Revise Before Launch rather than a silent Launch As-Is, and also assembles the summary row for the tracker sheet.

## Stage 3: Logging & Recommendation Delivery

A final Wait buffer respects downstream API rate limits before logging and delivery.

Save Focus Group Report to Google Sheets Tracker appends the summary row — every test is logged, regardless of outcome, building a history of campaign quality over time.

IF - Launch Ready branches on the AI's overall recommendation:
- Launch As-Is or Launch with Minor Edits: Send Campaign Ready Notification Email lets the growth marketing team know the campaign tested well, then the webhook responds with the full report.
- Revise Before Launch or Do Not Launch: Send Revision Required Notification Email gives the creative team the executive summary, top risks, and suggested copy changes, and the webhook responds with the same report detail — both fire in parallel.

assignments.value: ={{ $json.campaignCopy || $json.body?.campaignCopy || 'Subject: Your VIP Summer Perks Are Here. Body: You have earned it, unlock 25% off your next order plus free shipping, just for being one of our best customers. Perks this good do not last long.' }}

assignments.value: ={{ $json.offerDetails || $json.body?.offerDetails || '25% off sitewide plus free shipping, valid 5 days, loyalty members only' }}

assignments.value: ={{ $json.icpSegmentsJson || $json.body?.icpSegmentsJson || '[{"segmentName":"Budget-Conscious Parent","weight":0.35,"description":"35-45 year old parent, shops sales and coupons, price-sensitive, values family-friendly framing","painPoints":["Limited discretionary spend","Skeptical of urgency tactics"]},{"segmentName":"Loyalty Power User","weight":0.3,"description":"25-40 year old repeat customer already enrolled in the loyalty program, motivated by status and perks","painPoints":["Fatigue from frequent promo emails","Wants to feel recognized, not spammed"]},{"segmentName":"Gen Z Discovery Shopper","weight":0.2,"description":"18-24 year old who discovered the brand via social media, price-sensitive but values authenticity over discounts","painPoints":["Distrusts overly salesy copy","Short attention span"]},{"segmentName":"Premium Loyalist","weight":0.15,"description":"45-60 year old high-spend repeat customer, less price-driven, values quality and feeling like a VIP","painPoints":["Dislikes generic mass-market language","Wants exclusivity, not mass discounting"]}]' }}

  "status": "Campaign Input Insufficient",
  "panelReactionConfidence": {{ $json.panelReactionConfidence }},

nodes.name: AI - Generate Focus Group Synthesis & Recommendation

parameters.text:
=You are a market research analyst producing a pre-launch focus-group synthesis for a marketing lead, not a final go/no-go authority on its own.

Campaign Name: {{ $json.campaignName }}
Channel: {{ $json.campaignChannel }}
Budget At Stake: {{ $json.budgetAtStake }}

Composite Appeal Score: {{ $json.compositeAppealScore }}/100 ({{ $json.readinessTier }})
Weighted Purchase Intent: {{ $json.weightedPurchaseIntent }}/10
Weighted Clarity: {{ $json.weightedClarity }}/10
Weighted Sentiment Score: {{ $json.weightedSentimentScore }}/100
Objection Density: {{ $json.objectionDensity }} objections per persona
Top Recurring Objections: {{ JSON.stringify($json.topObjections) }}

Persona Reactions (JSON, one entry per simulated customer segment):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.personaReactions) }}

Guidance: Do Not Launch or Needs Revision tiers combined with high objection density should generally lean toward Revise Before Launch or Do Not Launch. Minor Tweaks Needed tier can lean toward Launch with Minor Edits. Launch Ready tier with low objection density can lean toward Launch As-Is. Always ground your reasoning in the actual numbers and persona quotes above.

Return a JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
{
  "overallRecommendation": "Launch As-Is|Launch with Minor Edits|Revise Before Launch|Do Not Launch",
  "executiveSummary": "Three to five sentence summary of how the panel reacted overall",
  "topStrengths": ["strength1", "strength2"],
  "topRisks": ["risk1", "risk2"],
  "suggestedCopyChanges": ["change1", "change2"],
  "segmentsToPrioritize": ["segmentName1"],
  "recommendationConfidence": <number 0-100>
}

Return ONLY the JSON object. No markdown, no explanation.
